name: MH3G #19 derived-attack candidate writeback
purpose_zh: 在一次受控的武器攻击变化中，验证 0x02867648 是攻击派生函数、r9 指向玩家状态、+0x6E8 是 16 位攻击值且 +0x6EC 是相邻显示浮点值。只记录，不修改寄存器或内存。
purpose_en: During one controlled weapon-attack change, prove that 0x02867648 is the attack-derivation function, r9 points to player state, +0x6E8 is the 16-bit attack value, and +0x6EC is the adjacent display float. Record only; do not alter registers or memory.
operator_steps_zh: 在稳定大厅记下当前面板攻击，准备一把攻击明显不同的武器；不要同时更换防具、护石或猫饭。
启动 tracer 后只更换一次准备好的武器，随后打开一次状态面板，不执行其他会改变攻击的动作。
只有 JSONL 命中与本次更换一致，且 r9+0x6E8 的半字与面板攻击变化相符、+0x6EC 同步变化时，才把该候选升级为 ppc-mapped。
operator_steps_en: In a stable lobby, note the current displayed attack and prepare one weapon with a clearly different attack value; do not also change armor, charms, or food.
After starting the tracer, equip only that weapon once and open the status panel once without performing another attack-changing action.
Promote the candidate to ppc-mapped only when the JSONL hit corresponds to that change, the halfword at r9+0x6E8 matches the displayed attack transition, and +0x6EC changes consistently.
